# fyre_cluster_details (Data Source)

Fetches details about a Fyre cluster, optionally including VM information.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster identifier (can be cluster ID or name)

### Optional

- `include_vms` (Boolean) Whether to include VM details in the response. Defaults to false.
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Cluster creation timestamp
- `description` (String) Cluster description
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier
- `name` (String) Cluster name
- `updated` (String) Cluster last update timestamp
- `user_id` (Number) User ID of the cluster owner
- `vms` (Attributes List) List of VMs in the cluster (only populated when include_vms is true) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `added_to_cluster` (String) Timestamp when VM was added to cluster
- `allow_floating_ip` (String) Whether floating IPs are allowed
- `auto_patch` (String) Auto-patch setting
- `compliance` (String) Compliance status
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPUs
- `created` (String) VM creation timestamp
- `created_iso8601` (String) VM creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format
- `current_owner` (Attributes) Current VM owner information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms--current_owner))
- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name
- `host_down` (String) Whether the host is down
- `hostname` (String) VM hostname
- `ips` (Attributes List) List of IP addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms--ips))
- `location` (String) VM location
- `memory` (Number) Memory in GB
- `os` (String) Operating system
- `os_disk` (Number) OS disk size in GB
- `platform` (String) Platform type (x, pvm, z)
- `product_group_id` (Number) Product group ID
- `state` (String) VM state
- `vm_id` (String) VM identifier

<a id="nestedatt--vms--current_owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms.current_owner`

Read-Only:

- `displayname` (String) Owner display name
- `email` (String) Owner email
- `user_id` (Number) Owner user ID
- `username` (String) Owner username


<a id="nestedatt--vms--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms.ips`

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String) IP address
